132	class Stylesheet(MediaAsset):
133	    element_template = '<link href="{path}"{attributes}>'
134	
135	    def __init__(self, href, **attributes):
136	        super().__init__(path=href, rel="stylesheet", **attributes)

139	@html_safe
140	class Media:
141	    def __init__(self, media=None, css=None, js=None):
142	        if media is not None:
143	            css = getattr(media, "css", {})
144	            js = getattr(media, "js", [])
145	        else:
146	            if css is None:
147	                css = {}
148	            if js is None:
149	                js = []
150	        self._css_lists = [self._normalize_css(css)]
151	        self._js_lists = [self._normalize_js(js)]
152	
153	    @staticmethod
154	    def _normalize_js(js):
155	        return [(path if hasattr(path, "__html__") else Script(path)) for path in js]
156	
157	    @staticmethod
158	    def _normalize_css(css):
159	        return {
160	            medium: [
161	                (path if hasattr(path, "__html__") else Stylesheet(path, media=medium))
162	                for path in paths
163	            ]
164	            for medium, paths in css.items()
165	        }
